notes.title: Play Scaredom Right Now !
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

We're thrilled to announce that [b]Scaredom's demo version is now available ![/b]
We hope you will enjoy what we've been working on.

The demo includes the prologue of the game, and a third of the first chapter.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

We'd love to hear your feedback !
Tell us what you think here : https://steamcommunity.com/app/1745810/discussions/0/3274690571068570344/

Thanks a lot for taking part in making Scaredom a better game.

[h2]Play Scaredom[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1745810/Scaredom/
